GameplayEvent Rules11 sections
How to Play

◆ In the Cloud Kingdom Games event, you can form teams for exploration and challenges.

◆ The goal is to keep advancing! Challenge Star Player and reach higher levels!

◆ At the start of the event, you must select five fellows to join you. Remember, changes cannot be made once confirmed for the duration of the event!

◆ When choosing fellows, the number of fellow types will determine different resonance effects activated. All Power Boost are only effecive in the event.

Team Rules

◆ During team formation, you can create, join, leave, or disband teams.

◆ Once the event begins, you cannot leave or disband teams.

◆ Creating a team is free the first time, but subsequent creations require crystals.

Advancement

◆ Each exploration consumes dice, randomizing a number between 1-6 to determine your steps forward.

◆ Dice rolls regenerate over time: 1 roll every 20 minutes. No regeneration upon reaching limit. You can also use Fusion Nut Bars or Double Nut Bars to recover.

◆ During exploration, you may encounter competitors, Olive Branches, Boost Gems, Goddess Statues, Support Flags, and various incidents, which will award you Super Achv Points.

◆ Get enough Super Achv Points to claim rewards in Super Achievements and Games Pass.

◆ Occasionally, a fork in the road will appear, requiring you to choose a path. Once chosen, the other route cannot be taken, but both lead to the same destination.

◆ Don't worry, the fork will eventually lead back to the same destination.

◆ Teammates' map progress is not shared, allowing independent management of routes.

Competitor

◆ Each arena features Normal Athletes and Elite Athletes who will challenge you upon encounter.

◆ Deploy 5 fellows for a 5v5 battle in a challenge. If you can't win, rearranging your fellows' positions may help.

◆ In a 5v5 battle, winning 3 out of 5 matches secures victory in the challenge, granting event points and rewards.

◆ If you fail, you can retry or give up the challenge. Giving up grants no points or rewards, but you can still proceed.

Star Player

◆ Defeat Normal or Elite Athletes to earn event points. Once you get enough points, the Star Player will appear.

◆ Defeating the Star Player grants generous rewards and allows progression to the next arena.

◆ If you can't defeat the Star Player, consider purchasing a Power Boost pack to enhance your strength for a retry, or choose to give up the challenge.

◆ Abandoning the challenge allows progression to the next arena with no rewards.

Goddess Statue

◆ Upon encountering a Goddess Statue during the exploration, 3 random blessings will be bestowed.

◆ Choose one blessing; obtaining the same blessing again improves its level and effect.

◆ Goddess blessings apply everywhere in the event and are cleared after it ends.

Support Flag

◆ During the exploration, you may encounter a Support Flag, allowing you to choose 1 fellow from your team to assist you.

◆ When challenging Normal Athletes, Elite Athletes, and Star Players, if your fellow faces insufficient power, you can deploy assistance fellows.

◆ Only 1 assistance fellow can be deployed per challenge, so choose wisely.

◆ Each assistance fellow has a limited number of uses. Once exhausted, they are removed from the assistance pool and must be invited again by encountering a Support Flag.

◆ If you prefer not to invite fellows of teammates, you can forgo the invitation for certain rewards.

Statue of Athena

◆ Collect Olive Branches as you progress. Your team’s Olive Branches will be added to the Statue of Athena.

◆ The Statue of Athena periodically produces Divinity based on the total Olive Branches collected.

◆ The statue stops producing Divinity after 48 hours, so remember to claim them!

◆ Divinity collected can enhance your fellows' power during the event for better challenges against athletes.

◆ If you've purchased the Premium Privilege, you may obtain Supreme Divinity through accumulating points, enhancing your fellows more efficiently.

◆ Note that Transcenders from other teams can challenge your members through plunders.

◆ If they succeed, they win some Olive Branches. Whether the challenge succeed or not, we won't lose any Olive Branches.

Lost Cargo

◆ Chubby Ginger has lost cargo on the field. Transcenders can assist in finding it during exploration.

◆ Once the cargo is found, Chubby Ginger will offer precious items at a discount for all teammates to purchase.

Leaderboards and Rewards

◆ The leaderboard features an overall and a daily leaderboard.

◆ The daily leaderboard resets daily, with rankings based on Divinity consumptions of individuals and teams.

◆ Enhance fellows by consuming Divinity to improve your ranking; Supreme Divinity will convert to Divinity consumption for leaderboard calculations based on a certain ratio.

◆ The overall leaderboard is settled at the end of the event, with rankings based on individual and team event points.

◆ After the leaderboards have been calculated, rewards can be claimed based on ranks.

◆ Unclaimed ranking rewards will be sent to you via mail.

In-Event Power

◆ In-Event Power = Fellow Power * (1 + In-Event Fellow Power Boost) * (1 + Type Bonus + Goddess Blessing + UR of current event Boost) + Boost Gem Bonus + Power Boost Bundle Bonus.
